item.tib: g.yung drung yongs su rdzogs pa'i dbang chog rgyas pa snang gsal me long rgyan gyi phreng ba
item.coloph: zhi ba g.yung drung yongs su rdzogs pa'i dbang chog snang gsal 'phrul gyi me long rgyas pa rgyan gyi dpal phreng zhes bya ba/ rang lugs kyi dkyil 'khor chen po stong dang drug brgya la nges pa'i snang ba thob pa dmu rgyal rnal 'byor nyi ma'i dbang pos/ chu mo lug lo zla ba drug pa'i tshes gcig la gtsug lag khang gi steng du brtsams shing grub par bgyis/ gzhung lugs sna mang nas btus pa dang / lhag par gling dgu'i lha la bdud rtsi phul bum dgu pa dang khog 'phrul byas//
